events.title: FREE Beer & Bites @ Dog & Owner Lookalike Contest Hosted by Dogfish Head
events.description:
Brewery teams up with Outkast’s Big Boi to crown NYC’s most matching human-and-hound duo. FREE to enter or attend!
This National Dog Day, Dogfish Head welcomes New Yorkers and their four-legged best friends to prove their resemblance at its inaugural Dog & Owner Lookalike Contest. Created to celebrate the wonderfully weird bond between people and their pups, this free event is open to dogs of every breed, size and personality (ok … their humans can come too). In addition to the evening’s main affair, the official Dog & Owner Lookalike Contest determined by an esteemed panel of celebrity judges, the event will feature a myriad of photo opportunities, giveaways, dog-friendly experiences and for guests 21+, refreshing pours from Dogfish Head’s portfolio of craft beers and ready-to-drink cocktails.
THE CONTEST – HOW IT WORKS:
Whether it’s matching curls, coordinated wardrobes, identical expressions or simply the same lovable energy, this is every dog and owner’s chance to compete for the title of New York City’s most perfectly paralleled pair. Contestants will strut their stuff before a panel of celebrity judges who will evaluate entries based on resemblance and overall showmanship. Contest judges include:
Antwan Andre Patton a.k.a. Big Boi: Best known as half of the iconic hip-hop duo, Outkast, Big Boi is also an animal lover and advocate for ostracized dog breeds.
@littlebearlumi: New York’s most beloved “pup-fluencer,” Lumi enjoys riding on the subway and skiing in his signature backpack as well as adventures in the city with his cat sister, Piper.
Sam Calagione: First and foremost the Brewer & Founder of Dogfish Head, Sam is also a proud dog-dad to Moxie and Maple, two mischievous chocolate labs.
Sign up for Dogfish Head’s Dog & Owner Lookalike Contest onsite, at the event, starting at 5 p.m., or pre-register HERE. Onsite signups will conclude at 5:59 p.m., sharp! Full contest rules and regulations can be found here.
THE PRIZES – WHAT YOU’LL WIN:
Contestants will compete for the chance to be called “Best in Show,” and the top three most unforgettable human-and-hound duos will receive the following prizes, courtesy of Dogfish Head and its event partners.
First-Place Grand Prize:
A year’s worth* of Dogfish Head beers and cocktails
A year’s worth of “Dog Bark” dog treats from Waggies by Maggie & Friends
A dog-friendly getaway to Dogfish Head’s home in Delaware, including: A three-night stay at the Dogfish INN, Dogfish Head’s beer-themed, canal-front hotel in Lewes, A Dogfish INN “Woof Pack” add-on package of dog-themed goodies, A $1,000 travel stipend to get to and from coastal Delaware with ease, A $250 Dogfish Head gift card to visit the brewery’s Milton Tasting Room and Rehoboth Beach restaurants (yep, they’re dog-friendly!)
A Dogfish Head swag package for both person and pup
A matching trophy and medal
Second Place Prize:
A one-year subscription to BARK BarkBox’s monthly themed toys and treats subscription
Two bags of “Dog Bark” dog treats from Waggies by Maggie & Friends
A Dogfish Head swag package for both person and pup
A matching trophy and medal
Third Place Prize:
Two bags of “Dog Bark” dog treats from Waggies by Maggie & Friends
A Dogfish Head swag package for both person and pup
A matching trophy and medal
THE PARTNERS – WHO YOU’LL SEE THERE:
Keeping with its commitment to bringing people together and doing good while having fun, Dogfish Head’s Dog & Owner Lookalike Contest is made possible by the generosity of its event partners: Waggies by Maggie & Friends, Priority Bicycles & Xtracycles, and BARK, the makers of BarkBox.
Additional entertainment, details and onsite programming will be announced closer to the event. For event updates and more on Dogfish Head, visit www.dogfish.com or follow @dogfishhead on Instagram.
*To be fulfilled via AMEX gift card containing the cash equivalent of one case of beer and one case of cocktails per month for 12 months.
**Dogfish Head’s Beer & Benevolence program will match the proceeds of the raffle with a monetary donation of up to $2,500.

events.title: Zine Club
events.description:
Join us every two weeks for Zine Club, a gathering dedicated to DIY bookmaking, self-publishing, creative experimentation, and community. Whether you’re new to zines or working on an ongoing project, this is a space to explore ideas, share work, and be creative in community with other artists, writers, activists, and creatives of all kinds.
Each begins with a quick demo of a technique or process you might incorporate in your own work. Explore a wide range of materials and techniques available in our studio, including collage, drawing, image transfer, stenciling, and printmaking.
Zine Club is led by Lista Studios instructor Wil Bigio, a graphic designer, illustrator, and dedicated doodler based in New York.
Details:
Meets every other Wednesday (first and third of the month) from 6:00 pm – 8:30 pm
Basic materials provided (paper, collage supplies, and printmaking tools)

events.title: Le San Culottes at Industry City + Hank’s Saloon Documentary
events.description:
Click here for tickets! https://wl.eventim.us/event/le-san-culottes-at-industry-city-hanks-saloon-documentary/700610?afflky=Getitrightthefirsttime
Industry City and Get It Right Music in association with Murmrr Presents are proud to welcome Les Sans Culottes to Industry City. And after the concert by one of the last bands to ever play the legendary Hank’s Saloon, we will be showing Leon Chase’s “Hank’s Saloon” documentary that will also feature an introduction and Q&A with filmmaker Leon Chase!
Please note: for the concert, there are approximately 60 seats and the rest of the space is standing room. For the movie, there will be about 100-150 seats.
Event Info
Date: August 29th, 2026
Doors: 3:00pm
Show: 3:30pm-6:00pm / 2 Sets
Movie screening: 6:30pm
Tickets: $15 advance / $20 day of show
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can get affordable drinks from the venue’s bar and order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall. Concert is rain or shine.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.
More on Les Sans Culottes:
Named after the citizen-soldiers of the French Revolution (and also the absence of “culottes”!), the Brooklyn-based French language septet, LES SANS CULOTTES, have been performing their inspired variety of 60’s inspired garage rock and French Pop since 1998, in NYC, across the U.S., Canada and France. The band is known for its high-energy, take-no-prisoners, cirque du slay- performance style and has released nine recordings.
More on the Hank’s Saloon Movie:
For over 100 years, Hank’s Saloon existed, under various names and owners, as a beloved local Brooklyn dive bar.
In 2018, after nearly a decade of speculation and financial uncertainty, the rickety little building on the corner of Third Avenue and Atlantic announced that they would finally be closing their doors for good.
This feature documentary follows Hank’s—along with its colorful staff and rotating cast of oddball patrons—through its stressful and celebratory final months. It also takes a deep-dive into the fascinating history of the building, from its roots as a working-class Irish bar, through its various roles as Prohibition-era speakeasy, Indigenous ironworker hangout, and safe haven in an era of danger and decay, up to its final state as a quintessential “old man bar” turned legendary indie music venue, all pitted against the backdrop of a rapidly changing New York.

events.description:

Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.

We invite you to taste and learn about sake where sake is made! Get a guided brewery tour, taste and explore a set of 5 premium sakes including some fresh from the press! Let’s level up your sake knowledge and have fun doing it!

A welcome sake to get you started!
Sake 101 presentation to cover all the basics
Guided Tasting of 4 Brooklyn Kura craft sakes as well as a premium sake from Japan.
